what: Every run of the fibre-network watercolour checks, failures included. Bounds file unchanged since 679f718.
deviation: The bounds file's source line says the street's albedo is the wash colour; the implementation and parity page use the street's display image (so a wash with no transport dries to the picture). The cases and numeric bounds are as committed.

runs.result: a fully wet sheet blurred the whole picture, and flocculation 3 to 6 drew dark scratch lines where near-parallel fibres overlap
runs.change: Wetness gated by the image's edges (water0 = clamp(1 - edgeDry |grad L|, 0.05, 1)), so bleeding stays inside regions; flocculation lowered to 0.3 to 1.5 by preset. The drop tests pass edgeDry 0, since the drop is itself an edge. Bounds unchanged.

runs.check: node tests and GPU parity after the change
runs.result: 5 of 5; 3 of 3 at max 1, mean under 0.003
